gloss: seagrass bed; seaweed bed; underwater meadow

definitions.gloss: seagrass bed; seaweed bed; underwater meadow
definitions.explanation: A shallow coastal area densely covered with seagrass or seaweed. Valued as a spawning and nursery ground for fish, and treated in environmental policy as a habitat to be protected and restored.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{藻場|もば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A seagrass bed spreads across the inner part of the bay.

examples.japanese: {藻場|もば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産卵場所|さんらんばしょ}になっている。
examples.english: Seagrass beds serve as spawning grounds for fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水温|すいおん}→水温：27380_suion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{藻場|もば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}り→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Rising water temperatures have caused the seagrass beds in this area to keep shrinking.

examples.japanese: {漁協|ぎょきょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧、⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧{藻場|もば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The fishery cooperative and the university have jointly begun an effort to restore the lost seagrass beds.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{藻|も}→藻：14821_mo⟧ (algae, water plants) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place). A technical term from fisheries and marine conservation, common in news coverage of coastal environments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藻場|もば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: seagrass beds spread
- {藻場|もば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧: restoration of seagrass beds
- {藻場|もば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消失|しょうしつ}→消失：13351_shoushitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: seagrass beds disappear

RELATED WORDS:
- {磯焼|いそや}け: barren ground — the loss of seaweed beds along rocky coasts, the problem {藻場|もば} restoration addresses
- ⟦{干潟|ひがた}→干潟：05592_higata⟧: tidal flat — another shallow-water habitat protected for similar reasons
